# M4 Generated-Code Ownership Contract

M4-08 adds one normal generation/write path for the M4-02 through M4-07 outputs without changing their canonical-IR-only semantic contracts.

`tools/generate_m4.py` invokes the existing domain, Fastify API, PostgreSQL persistence, transaction, idempotency, and outbox generators. Only after every generator succeeds does it pass the complete file set through `tools/generated_ownership.py`.

## Ownership marker

Every generated TypeScript file starts with:

```text
// @generated by AIDL; ownership=aidl; sha256=<64 lowercase hex digits>
```

Every generated SQL file starts with:

```text
-- @generated by AIDL; ownership=aidl; sha256=<64 lowercase hex digits>
```

The digest is SHA-256 of the exact UTF-8 body after the marker line. It is deterministic and lets the writer distinguish an intact AIDL-owned file from an unmarked, foreign-owned, damaged, or manually edited target.

## Safe regeneration

`generate_and_write_m4(ir, root)` generates the complete M4 file set in memory before touching destinations. `write_generated_files` then validates every proposed path/content and every existing destination before staging any replacement.

An existing destination is replaceable only when its marker uses the AIDL owner and its digest matches its current body. Any unmarked, foreign, damaged, or tampered target aborts the whole preflight before the first target mutation. Already marked files can be regenerated normally.

Replacement uses same-directory temporary files and `os.replace`. If replacement itself fails after one or more files have moved into place, the writer restores prior bytes for replaced files (or removes newly created files) before re-raising. Generated files therefore are not manual repair targets.

Only `.ts` and `.sql` paths below `generated/` are accepted by this M4 writer. Build/run behavior, application startup scaffolding, messaging-provider binding, and end-to-end execution remain later M4 work.
